piExt_desc: Manage extensions for the Pi coding agent. Install npm packages to extend Pi's capabilities.
piExt_mcpAdapterCardDesc: Adds MCP (Model Context Protocol) support to Pi. With this extension, Pi can connect to MCP servers, discover and call MCP tools. Without it, Pi MCP configurations in AgentCabin are not consumed by the Pi runtime.
piExt_permissionSystemCardDesc: Pi's centralized permission engine (@gotgenes/pi-permission-system) enforces global, project, and agent-scoped allow / deny / ask rules across tools, commands, paths, and external directories. AgentCabin switches between rule-based prompts and Auto Approve (yoloMode): Auto Approve rewrites ask to allow but preserves explicit deny rules, and changes are re-read before the next agent turn.
piExt_permissionSystemToggleDesc: When enabled, Pi loads the @gotgenes/pi-permission-system extension at startup for permission control.
piExt_planModeCardDesc: Read-only planning mode for Pi. Enter /plan to restrict tools to read-only exploration, ask structured questions via plan_mode_question, and submit plans via plan_mode_complete. No edit/write until plan is approved. Does not handle permission control or auto-continue.
piExt_goalCardDesc: Continuous goal-driven execution for Pi. Keeps the agent running across turns to achieve a defined objective, with pause/resume, blocked reporting, and goal_complete on success.
piExt_rpivWebToolsCardDesc: Pi web tools (@juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools) with configurable backends such as Exa. Returns search results directly, fetches pages through web_fetch including dynamic content, and can shallow-clone GitHub repositories into a local cache. Use /web-tools in Pi to configure Exa after installation.
piExt_fffCardDesc: High-performance file search extension for Pi (@ff-labs/pi-fff). Adds fffind and ffgrep tools for rapid fuzzy file matching and parallel searching (supports override mode for built-in tools).
piExt_lensCardDesc: Full code intelligence for Pi (pi-lens): LSP diagnostics and navigation, impact analysis, linters, type-checking, structural search, and project intelligence.
piExt_subagentsCardDesc: Shared Code and Work multi-agent delegation extension (pi-subagents). Supports background execution, automatic resume, and asynchronous mailbox delivery; Work adds its own policy adapter.
piExt_contextPruneCardDesc: Context pruning extension for long Pi sessions (pi-context-prune). Preserves full session history while trimming old tool results submitted to LLM; recommended conservative agent-message mode preserves Prefix Cache.
piExt_contextUsageCardDesc: Context diagnostics for Pi (pi-context-usage). Use /context to inspect estimated system prompt, tools, conversation, and turn-token usage without changing the agent's behavior.
piExt_cacheGraphCardDesc: Cache diagnostics for Pi (pi-cache-graph). Use /cache stats or /cache graph to inspect cache reads, writes, and hit-rate trends across turns.
piExt_caffeinateCardDesc: Cross-platform system sleep prevention extension for Pi (@narumitw/pi-caffeinate). Prevents OS sleep across macOS, Windows, Linux, and WSL during long agent tasks, goal execution, or background subagent runs.
piExt_chromeDevtoolsCardDesc: Chrome DevTools automation extension for Pi (@narumitw/pi-chrome-devtools). Enables Chrome/Chromium remote debugging, screenshots, DOM inspection, and page analysis (requires Chromium-based browser).
piExt_multiEditCardDesc: Batch and multi-file patch editing extension for Pi (pi-mono-multi-edit). Upgrades single-file substring edits into unified multi-file diff patches similar to Codex apply_patch, reducing turns and improving precision.
piExt_hint: Extensions are installed globally (user scope) via Pi's native package manager. Restart Pi after installing.
